Dear Miss Yonge	
The end of the [M.S](../books.html#72). reached [me](../persons.html#379) with your letter. I at once sent it to the Printer.

Whatever alteration you may wish to make either in [illegible] or modifying can be done in the proof.
[Miss Martin](../persons.html#971) - whom I saw yesterday - agreed with me in this.

Yours very [illegible]
Geo Lillie Craik

[^1]: Frances Martin was the editor of [Macmillan\'s Sunday Library](../others.html#145), in which CMY\'s The Pupils of St.

John the Divine was going to appear.
